description: This is a test class for the HandlerUtil utility, specifically testing methods related to retrieving and handling validator classes and handlers within the OpenMRS framework. It uses JUnit 5 for testing the behavior of HandlerUtil methods.

classes.name: HandlerUtilTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the HandlerUtil utility methods related to validators and handlers in the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: getHandlersForType_shouldReturnAListOfAllClassesThatCanHandleThePassedType
methods.description: Tests that the getHandlersForType method returns the correct list of handlers for a given class type.

methods.name: getHandlersForType_shouldReturnAnEmptyListIfNoClassesCanHandleThePassedType
methods.description: Tests that getHandlersForType returns an empty list when no handlers can handle the specified type.

methods.name: getPreferredHandler_shouldReturnThePreferredHandlerForThePassedHandlerAndType
methods.description: Confirms that getPreferredHandler returns the expected handler for a specific type.

methods.name: getPreferredHandler_shouldThrowAAPIExceptionExceptionIfNoHandlerIsFound
methods.description: Verifies that getPreferredHandler throws an APIException if no suitable handler is found.

methods.name: getPreferredHandler_shouldReturnPatientValidatorForPatient
methods.description: Checks that getPreferredHandler returns an instance of PatientValidator when asked for a validator for Patient.

methods.name: getPreferredHandler_shouldReturnPersonValidatorForPerson
methods.description: Checks that getPreferredHandler returns an instance of PersonValidator when asked for a validator for Person.
